quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West names Mike Tyson as his favorite boxer
quotes.excerpt: I'm sticking to my story. Going with Mike Tyson over everybody.
quotes.quote: I'm sticking to my story. Going with Mike Tyson over everybody.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West reflects on his former NBA teammates
quotes.excerpt: I was blessed to play with so many NBA legends and greats. Tony Allen, Kendrick Perkins, Al Jefferson.
quotes.quote: I was blessed to play with so many NBA legends and greats. Tony Allen, Kendrick Perkins, Al Jefferson, Mo Williams, Jameer Nelson. I played with so many, man. Their skills on the court wasn't what made them great. It was something about their personalities and how they carried themselves that translated onto the court. I got to experience that part of it.

quotes.speaker: Best Buy Employee
quotes.summary_phrase: Best Buy employee discusses his favorite NBA players

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who is your favorite NBA player of all time?

text_blocks.speaker: Best Buy Employee
text_blocks.text: I mean, if I'm going to go old school, you got to say LeBron James. I mean, LeBron is LeBron. But I'm always going to say who are the greats, and I'm going to say LeBron. And I'm going to say Michael Jordan.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West recalls playing against James Harden
quotes.excerpt: We had some good times in the playoffs, man. That was my rookie, I was in Seattle.
quotes.quote: We had some good times in the playoffs, man. That was my rookie, I was in Seattle before they went to Oklahoma. James Harden and Russell Westbrook, we had some good times in the playoffs. He took the step-back with the left, he took it to a whole new level.
